messages:
sara_sales: Quick sync — Zenith wants a reserved capacity commit with 99.9% SLA. Traffic peak ~3k RPS for chat generation (mix: 70% short prompts ~50 tokens, 30% long ~600 tokens). Asking for preheat + AZ spread. Can infra/ML help with sizing and a fallback plan?

edward_se: Do we know model choice? That changes GPU/latency a lot. Also need expected concurrency per user vs bursty fanout.

sara_sales: They plan to use an Llama-variant (7B quantized) for most routes, with a smaller 3B for low-latency assistants. We can propose a canary on 7B then fallback to 3B if queueing.

maria_ml: For 7B quantized on our runtime: sustain tokens/sec per A100-ish GPU ~= 1.2M tokens/sec (conservative). With 70/30 token mix, estimate avg tokens/request ~= 210. At 3k RPS that’s 630k tokens/sec => ~0.53 GPU if purely ideal. Add KB cache K/V warmup and tail latency, plan 1.2x-1.5x buffer. Suggest 1 dedicated GPU per AZ for baseline, plus 1 shared hot standby for burst.

chris_eng: +1 to buffer. Also factor in sequence-length variance and KV cache cold starts — cold client windows will spike CPU/GPU at attach. Recommend autoscale policy with prewarm: maintain min_replicas=1 per AZ, burst_goal=2 for 5m windows, scale up threshold qps>80% capacity for 30s.

ops_bot: Deploy-sim results attached: peak-sim 3k RPS -> recommended reserved GPUs: 4 GPUs (spread across 3 AZs), expected p95 gen latency = 210ms with batching on.

edward_se: Can we translate "4 GPUs" into a pricing/commit ask? Sales needs monthly cost delta vs hosted burst credits.

sara_sales: Yes. Also they asked about graceful degradation modes in case reserved capacity is exhausted (legal wants failover plan).

maria_ml: Fallback stack preference: 1) route to 3B quantized in same region (fastest) 2) route to hosted multi-tenant tier in another region (higher latency, lower cost) 3) apply conservative response trimming (truncate long outputs) + degrade sampling temp. Routing policy should be policy-based.

chris_eng: Implementation notes: add route policy with capacity tags and a fallback time budget (e.g., 300ms). Use model-variant compatibility table so stateful sessions pick nearest compatible fallback to preserve semantics.

anna_security: Also they returned the security questionnaire asking about isolation and key handling if we run Dedicated. Need 'Dedicated' KMS/HSM section and audit retention answers.

sara_sales: Can ops provide a short paragraph for the questionnaire about KMS + data flow for dedicated? They want it by EOD tomorrow.

ops_bot: Template snippet for questionnaire: "Dedicated deployments support customer-managed KMS integrations (AWS KMS, GCP KMS, Azure Key Vault). Data plane logs can be configured to redact PII; audit logs retained as per contract. Network isolation via VPC peering and optional on-prem package available." (copy/paste)

maria_ml: Back to sizing: if we allow 15% headroom for model upgrades and slight traffic growth, recommend commit = 5 GPUs reserved (3 AZs: 2/1/2 or 2/2/1 depending on AZ capacity) with autoscale burst credits for extra demand. That gives ~1.5x elastic cushion.

edward_se: For pricing calc: use committed monthly rate * 5 + burst credit buffer pricing. I'll draft numbers and post.

sara_sales: Ops/ML — can you confirm preheat plan? We need a runbook: cold-start KV warmup, synthetic preheat traffic, and a sanity smoke test ramp.

chris_eng: Preheat checklist (short):
```
- preheat window: 30 mins prior to predicted peak
- run synthetic warmup: 10% of peak QPS per worker for 10m
- KV cache priming: replay representative prompts set (provided by customer)
- validate p95 tail with tracing hooks
- circuit breaker thresholds set (qps, queue depth, p99 latency)
```

anna_security: Also note compliance ask: they want SOC2 + custom retention for logs. We can offer enterprise add-on for 1yr retention and cross-account audit.

sara_sales: Perfect. Next actions: Maria/chris to confirm GPU count & preheat steps by EOD, Edward to produce pricing comparison (reserved vs burst), Anna to fill the KMS/audit snippet into questionnaire. I'll coordinate with customer. :thumbsup:

maria_ml: Filing final sizing note now — will attach perf numbers in shared doc.

chris_eng: I'll add the route policy draft to infra repo and link it here when ready.

edward_se: Pricing draft uploaded: https://redwood.internal/sales/zenith/pricing-draft-v1 (comments welcome).

ops_bot: Reminder: runbook template created: /ops/runbooks/preheat-template.yaml

sara_sales: Thanks team — sync call if needed tomorrow morning 09:30 PT.
